scope.summary: Implement seeded randomization per Section 13.17 (BK-17.4, TAI-BK-055), closing SREQ-007/008: whole-body, per-region, and per-channel randomization scopes with plausibility-weighted distributions and deterministic seeds — the same (seed, scope, base_mesh_version, registry version) reproduces the identical channel map; batch variation generation (N bodies from N seeds) runs as parallel jobs, and every randomization emits TailorBodyRandomized with seed and scope in the payload.
acceptance_criteria: randomize(body_id, scope: WholeBody | Region(group_key) | Channel(channel_key), seed: u64) samples channel values from per-channel plausibility distributions (registry-declared weighting, defaulting to center-weighted within [min, max] and rare tail into design_max) and applies them as ordinary channel edits.

Determinism: identical (seed, scope, base_mesh_version, registry_version) input yields a bit-identical channel map across two runs; changing any tuple element changes the output (both directions tested).
Region scope touches only channels of the named group (post-run assertion on all other groups); channel scope touches exactly one channel.
TailorBodyRandomized event is registered in the tailor.body family and emitted with { body_id, seed, scope, changed_channel_count }.
Batch mode: generate_variations(recipe_id, seeds: Vec<u64>) enqueues N independent jobs through the existing Handshake JOBS lane (leases/cancellation honored) each producing a body from one seed.
scope.risk_if_missed: Non-deterministic or scope-leaking randomization poisons batch production (the operator's variation workflow): irreproducible bodies cannot be re-generated for reshoots, and whole-body noise wrecking a dialed breast setup destroys trust in the randomizer as a production tool.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
